name.en: Single-axis tracker on torque tube (1P, pile-supported)
name.es: Seguidor de un eje sobre tubo de torsión (1P, sobre pilotes)

description.en: Single-axis tracker: a round or rectangular torque tube, rotated by a slew drive or rotating gear drive, runs along each row on bearings supported by piles. Modules are fixed to the torque tube with single-fastener clamps that include grounding. Two manufacturers' datasheets are summarized; most dimensions, grades and torques are not stated.
description.es: Seguidor de un eje: un tubo de torsión redondo o rectangular, girado por un accionamiento de tipo slew o de engranaje rotativo, recorre cada fila sobre cojinetes apoyados en pilotes. Los módulos se fijan al tubo con mordazas de un solo tornillo con puesta a tierra incluida. Se resumen las fichas de dos fabricantes; la mayoría de dimensiones, calidades y pares no se indican.

typical_use: Utility-scale single-axis tracking with 1P (portrait) or 2P module layouts along a row, with terrain-following options for some models.
applicable_standards: IEC 62817 (design qualification of solar trackers; listed, not reviewed in full)
UL 2703 / UL 3703 (listing; Array approval press release)

geometry.description: No dimensions of the torque tube, bearings, pile spacing or tracker row length are sourced. No geometry elements are modelled.

reference_layout.note: Nextracker datasheet: 1x module in portrait; row size configurable per module type, string length and site. Array DuraTrack HZ v3: tilt +/-52 degrees standard, +/-62 degrees optional (tilt_range_deg uses the standard value).

quantity.note: One drive per row is typical for this type; the Array sheet gives 2 HP, 3 phase, 480 V AC for its motor; count not stated by the source
Count per row not stated; 1 is the typical value

grounding_bonding: Array states its single-fastener clamps include integrated grounding; no grounding conductor sizes are stated.
installation_notes: Array DuraTrack HZ v3: single-fastener, high-speed mounting clamps with integrated grounding; no lubrication required for dry slide bearings.
Nextracker NX Horizon: configurable up to 240 km/h (150 mph) 10 m 3-second gust; defensive stow functions; vibration-proof fastening system (grades not stated).
Array DuraTrack HZ v3: 140 mph allowable wind load, 3-second gust, exposure C, per ASCE 7-10; snow rating not stated.
Tracker control, communication and rated tracking angles are outside this structural entry and are not covered.
